You are repairing 11 tests that fail after deliberate Scene 1A package changes in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. You may edit ONLY tests and their fixtures/generated expectations under tests/, plus this one lint fix: .plans/1a-transcript-continuity/baseline_replay.py line ~98 (a print line over the ruff line limit: wrap it, nothing else). NEVER edit storygame/, data/, bench/frozen/, tests/fixtures/continuity_initiative_pre_3c_adoption/, docs/testing-runbook.md. Do not weaken an assertion beyond what the intended change requires, and do not delete a test.

THE INTENDED PACKAGE CHANGES (all deliberate, already committed): (1) Scene 1A `min_turns` is now 9 (was 8) and the 1A to 1B timer exit comes about five turns later, because the old pacing event `pressure_1a` (turn 4) was replaced by `patrol_arrives_1a` (4), `patrol_enters_1a` (5), `patrol_leaves_1a` (7) and `patrol_returns_1a` (9), of which `patrol_leaves_1a` sets patrol_departed true and patrol_on_scene and patrol_in_house FALSE; (2) k_sl_1a_f_r1 and k_sl_1a_f_r2 (drawer pointers) now require memory_card_recovered equals false; (3) new reveal k_sl_1a_b_r0w (storylet SL-1A-E realization SL-1A-E-R2) fires instead of k_sl_1a_b_r0 while patrol_in_house is true, and k_sl_1a_b_r0 now requires patrol_in_house equals false; (4) reveals k_sl_1a_b_r0, k_sl_1a_b_r0w, k_sl_1a_f_r1, k_sl_1a_f_r2 carry reach_entity_ids [michelle_drawer], so they are not eligible unless the protagonist is in the same area as the drawer.

THE FAILING TESTS (current failure in brackets). Fix each by updating its expectation to the new intended behavior, EXCEPT where noted:
1. tests/test_cue_eligibility_compare.py::test_real_package_reports_no_real_spent_cases_and_not_stageable_1a_case and tests/test_cue_spent_reveal.py::test_old_and_new_real_cue_predicates_differ_only_for_spent_rows [the real package now has an extra row ('1A', 'SL-1A-E fired through k_sl_1a_b_r0w', 'continuity_initiative_known', True, False)]: add that row to the pinned set, after checking it is the same kind of row as the existing 'SL-1A-E fired through k_sl_1a_b_r0' one.
2. tests/test_game_path_completion.py (three parametrized cases for patrol_leaves_1a and patrol_enters_1a) [a generic loop asserts every event effect fact is true after the event fires]: make the check honor each effect's `equals` (true or false) instead of assuming true; keep it generic (no event names); and check why `test_pressure_event_fires_only_once[patrol_enters_1a]` fails and fix its premise (patrol_enters_1a has a `when` that needs patrol_on_scene true; patrol_leaves_1a needs patrol_on_scene true).
3. tests/test_attempt_bundle.py::test_authored_transition_on_a_no_reveal_turn_is_earned [8 turns now < min_turns 9]: run the extra turn(s) needed so the transition is earned at the new minimum; keep the assertion that it is earned and not a timeout.
4. tests/test_3c_carried_start.py::test_carried_run_row_uses_scene_turns_from_one_without_network [prefix_turn_index 60 != 59] and tests/test_3c_no_close_arm.py::test_existing_arm_dry_run_remains_byte_stable [a stored byte-stable dry-run fixture differs at one digit]: the carried 3C prefix runs through 1A, which is one turn longer, so the expected index is 60 and the stored fixture must be regenerated. Find how the fixture is produced (read the test and the script it calls) and regenerate ONLY with that script; confirm by diff that the only change is the expected turn index/digit(s), and report the diff.
5. tests/test_drawer_avoidance_repro.py::test_static_drawer_dependencies_have_no_later_scene_dependents [the drawer-only fact set no longer contains memory_card_recovered]: read the test; if the new set is explained by change (2) or (3) update it and say why.
6. INVESTIGATE FIRST, do not blindly edit: tests/test_invitation_report.py::test_1a_drawer_cue_has_an_eligible_response [no row ends with ' | eligible response' for the 1A drawer cue] and tests/test_knowledge_timeline_script.py::test_knowledge_timeline_script_replays_eligible_prefix_and_rejects_future_selection [selected ids differ from ['k_sl_1a_b_r0', 'k_future_invalid']]. Read what each checks and why it now differs. If the cause is one of the intended changes above (for example the test never moves the protagonist, drives a scripted prefix that now needs the reach rule or the patrol_in_house split, or counts turns), update the test to the new intended behavior and explain. If the cause looks like a REAL REGRESSION (the drawer cue truly has no eligible response in the real game, or the timeline can no longer reach the card reveal for a protagonist who is in the house), STOP, change nothing for that test, and report precisely what you found with the command that reproduces it.

TESTS FIRST does not apply (these are existing tests); instead, for each fix state in your final report which of the intended changes explains it. FINISH: ruff format and ruff check every .py you touched; run the check.
